name: Implement QAOA (p=3) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with ed
task_prompt: Implement QAOA (p=3) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 3), (1, 2), (2, 3)]. Build the cost and mixer layers manually, optimize with scipy, and print the best cut found. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
